content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|Payment Infrastructure]] layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-usdt-payment-gateways-9|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-know-about-bitcoin-payments-digital-11|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-8. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads enable creators to receive payments directly in cryptocurrency without relying on traditional payment processors that charge exorbitant fees. For example, platforms like Gumroad take up to 10% on every sale, which can quickly add up and eat into profits. In contrast, services like NOWPayments only charge 0.5%, significantly increasing the net revenue for creators. This model not only reduces costs but also provides financial independence and flexibility, allowing creators to maintain full control over their income streams.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads relies on several key components that work together seamlessly. At the core, you have a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, where your digital products are stored and accessible. The payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which verifies transactions on-chain and offers automated notifications upon payment confirmation. Backend logic can be implemented using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders and deliver products instantly. This setup ensures that creators are not dependent on any third-party platforms, allowing for complete ownership of their sales and customer data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products often find themselves unable to process payments efficiently. This solution empowers them to bypass the limitations imposed by traditional financial systems and enables them to scale their businesses. By adopting Bitcoin payments, these creators can reach a global audience, enhance their earning potential, and operate with financial sovereignty.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on transactions, allowing you to keep more revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of using Bitcoin for digital downloads hinges on several interconnected components. Begin with a reliable hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency processing, ensuring quick and secure transactions. Use backend services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order fulfillment and product delivery. Finally, ensure that you have proper storage solutions in place, such as Supabase or Google Drive, to securely hold your digital products. This ecosystem creates a robust framework for selling digital goods without the typical platform constraints.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own Bitcoin payment solution for digital downloads, start by setting up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Use backend logic to manage your orders with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Once your setup is complete, upload your digital products to your chosen storage solution and ensure everything is linked correctly. Test the entire process end-to-end to confirm that payments and deliveries work smoothly. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for an efficient deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage a cryptocurrency payment processor like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies directly, bypassing conventional payment platforms entirely. This approach minimizes fees and maximizes your income from sales, making it a viable option for digital creators looking to monetize their work effectively.
Bypassing traditional platforms provides you with full ownership of your sales.

If you’re looking to sell digital products without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack, ensuring you can sell your products with minimal fees. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
